name: Ratio Format 14 Choice
definition: Choice of format to expressed a ratio.

QuantityToQuantity.name: Quantity To Quantity
QuantityToQuantity.definition: Ratio expressed as a quotient of quantities.

NotSpecifiedRate.name: Not Specified Rate
NotSpecifiedRate.definition: Value of the ratio not specified.

AmountToAmount.name: Amount To Amount
AmountToAmount.definition: Ratio expressed as a quotient of amounts.

AmountToQuantity.name: Amount To Quantity
AmountToQuantity.definition: Ratio expressed as an amount to quantity ratio.

QuantityToAmount.name: Quantity To Amount
QuantityToAmount.definition: Ratio expressed as a quantity to amount ratio.

CoexistenceQuantityRule.definition: During ISO 15022 – 20022 coexistence, Quantity length must not be greater than 15, including the decimal point.

CoexistenceAmountRule.definition: During ISO 15022 – 20022 coexistence, Amount length must not be greater than 15, including the decimal point.
